Per Stellar share, the Merger Consideration consists of $11.36 in cash and 0.3803 shares of Prosperity Common Stock per Stellar share.
Per Stellar share: (i) 11.36 in cash (Per Share Cash Consideration) and (ii) 0.3803 shares of Prosperity Common Stock (Exchange Ratio). The Merger Consideration is the sum of these components. The Aggregate Stock Consideration may be capped at 19.9% of Prosperity's outstanding stock; if exceeded, the Exchange Ratio is reduced to meet the cap and the Per Share Cash Consideration is increased by an amount equal to the Prosperity Share Closing Price times the difference between the initial and adjusted Exchange Ratio (per share). In addition, the merger contemplates cash in lieu of fractional shares and any dividends or distributions payable in respect of the Prosperity stock upon exchange.
0.3803 Prosperity Common Stock per Stellar Common Stock, plus $11.36 cash per Stellar share; the fixed exchange ratio is 0.3803 shares, with cash per share of $11.36. The Exchange Ratio can be adjusted downward if the aggregate Prosperity stock to be issued would exceed the cap (19.9%), with the cash component increased accordingly under Section 1.5(b).
